verdict.rationale: Integrating native JavaScript libraries through direct DOM access is a fair question for a UI framework, but the evidence pack never shows how Vue supports it: there is nothing on template refs, mount lifecycle hooks or custom directives. The only nearby items are general statements that Vue 'builds on top of standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript' and can be added incrementally to old apps. Neither describes DOM manipulation or wrapping third-party charting or visualization libraries.
